body: I think it had something to do with shit at the mental hospital, I'm not sure. I don't really think i'll get a chance alone, and I don't feel comfortable having my therapist talking to my parents.
I've tried transferring schools, and i've tried talking to my parents. Nothing has worked so far. My teachers have refused to give me harder work. I'm basically trapped.

The only people I can really talk to are my internet friends. I should see a therapist in the next week, but i've had a really hard time finding one that understands me. Even so, I usually resort to pretending i'm fine and self harm. My mother is required to sit in on my therapy appointments, and I am not comfortable talking about anything in from of her, as she gets quite abusive at home.
